templates.label: Binary over/under
templates.summary: Players forecast whether the settlement value lands at or above the asking price.
templates.settlement_rule: OVER wins when actual_price >= asking_price; UNDER wins otherwise.
limitations: Simulation credits only.
The asking price is the only threshold in this market format.

templates.label: Range price band
templates.summary: Players forecast which settlement price band the property lands in.
templates.settlement_rule: Resolve to below_band, inside_band, or above_band using the configured price band.
limitations: Playable through the room API, rendered host/player room UI, and server event/replay path.
The current chart and AI bot workflows remain binary-first.
AI bot trading remains disabled for range rooms.

templates.label: Rent yield over/under
templates.summary: Players forecast whether annualized rent yield clears a configured threshold.
templates.settlement_rule: OVER wins when annual_rent / settlement_price >= yield_threshold.
limitations: Simulation credits only.
The host must provide public-safe settlement price and annual-rent evidence.
AI bot trading remains disabled for rent-yield rooms.

templates.label: Time on market over/under
templates.summary: Players forecast whether days on market exceeds a configured threshold.
templates.settlement_rule: OVER wins when measured days_on_market >= days_threshold.
limitations: Simulation credits only.
The host must provide public-safe listing lifecycle evidence.
Listing lifecycle evidence ingestion is not automated yet.
AI bot trading remains disabled for time-on-market rooms.

templates.label: Renovation budget over/under
templates.summary: Players forecast whether verified renovation cost exceeds a configured budget.
limitations: Simulation credits only.
The host must provide public-safe cost evidence.
AI bot trading remains disabled for renovation-budget rooms.

templates.label: Neighborhood price momentum over/under
templates.summary: Draft contract for forecasting whether a ZIP-code neighborhood median price clears a configured future threshold.
templates.settlement_rule: OVER wins when verified future_median_price is at or above the configured price_momentum_threshold for the selected ZIP-code comparison window; UNDER wins otherwise.
limitations: Draft-only: blocked from room creation until neighborhood market pricing, evidence ingestion, and settlement review are implemented.
The current baseline can be generated only from FairValue static ZIP-code aggregates.
Settlement would require future provider-backed neighborhood snapshots, not manual claims or property-level anecdotes.

templates.label: Neighborhood rent yield over/under
templates.summary: Draft contract for forecasting whether a ZIP-code neighborhood gross rent yield clears a configured future threshold.
templates.settlement_rule: OVER wins when verified annualized median rent divided by verified future median price is at or above yield_threshold for the selected ZIP-code comparison window; UNDER wins otherwise.
limitations: Draft-only: blocked from room creation until rent-provider evidence ingestion and neighborhood settlement tooling are implemented.
The current baseline uses static rent estimates and asking or observed prices where available.
It is not an underwriting, lending, or investment recommendation.

templates.label: Neighborhood outperformance over/under
templates.summary: Draft contract for forecasting whether a ZIP-code neighborhood return outperforms a benchmark region over a configured window.
templates.settlement_rule: OVER wins when verified subject_region_return minus benchmark_region_return is at or above outperformance_threshold for the configured comparison window; UNDER wins otherwise.
limitations: Draft-only: blocked from room creation until benchmark definitions, provider snapshots, and settlement dispute handling exist.
The current ZIP entity is not a formal neighborhood boundary or investable index.
Benchmark choice must be disclosed before market launch and cannot be changed after bets are accepted.
